packages.label: הַעֲלָאַת מַיִּין נוּקְבִין וְהַשָּׁלוֹם
packages.label_en: Elevation of Feminine Waters and Peace
packages.reason: The largest connected component in Torah #75 centers on הַעֲלָאַת מַיִּין נוּקְבִין (elevation of feminine waters) as the master concept: it is a bechina of שלום (peace), of the act of the peacemaker (העושה שלום), of an answer to a question (תרוץ resolving apparent contradiction), and of Torah-and-Prayer speech in all its forms (תורה ותפלה, כל הדבורים שמדברים בתורה ותפלה). All of these concepts share the same essential nature: the unifying, integrative, upward-drawing quality that resolves fragmentation into coherence. Four small isolated components are merged here because their shared bechina nature aligns with this cluster: (A) דם + נפש — blood is the soul (נפש), which is the latent form of the sparks before they are brought into holy speech; this is the raw material of the elevation process and shares the essential nature of 'unspoken potential.' (B) העולמות + אותיות — the fallen worlds are letters, the scattered units that must be gathered and combined through holy Torah-Prayer speech; they share the nature of 'the material that undergoes the elevation/unification.' (C) צדק + דבור של תורה ותפלה — tzedek is the speech of Torah and prayer (as in צֶדֶק תְּדַבֵּרוּן); it is the righteous quality that Torah/Prayer speech embodies, directly part of the elevation domain. The עמידה node (standing) is included because תורה ותפלה = עמידה, which connects through this cluster via the תורה ותפלה node.

merge_notes.reason: Blood is a bechina of the soul (כִּי נֶפֶשׁ כָּל בָּשָׂר דָּמוֹ בְּנַפְשׁוֹ הוּא). In this Torah the Rebbe explains that the sparks/niצוצות, before being brought into holy speech, are in a state of דם (blood). Blood = soul = the latent, pre-verbal form of the divine sparks. This is the substrate of the entire elevation process. The domain is: sparks-before-elevation = blood = soul. This shares the essential nature of 'raw material that undergoes the הַעֲלָאַת מַיִּין נוּקְבִין process' and is most thematically cohesive with Package 1.

The fallen worlds are a bechina of letters (הָעוֹלָמוֹת הֵן בְחִינַת אוֹתִיּוֹת). The teaching states that at the time of creation the worlds fell and scattered as niצוצות/letters. These letters need to be combined (צֵרוּף) through Torah/Prayer speech. The domain is: scattered fallen worlds = unassembled letters = what must be gathered and unified. This shares the essential nature of 'the material of the elevation and unification process' — the same domain as Package 1.

Tzedek is a bechina of the speech of Torah and Prayer (צֶדֶק, הוּא בְחִינַת הַדִּבּוּר שֶׁל תּוֹרָה וּתְפִלָּה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב צֶדֶק תְּדַבֵּרוּן). This pair directly describes the righteous quality of holy speech, which is one of the core elements of the הַעֲלָאַת מַיִּין נוּקְבִין cluster. Tzedek = holy speech = the same domain as Torah/Prayer/elevation.

packages.label: רַגְלִין — תּוֹרָה וּתְפִלָּה כְּעֲמִידָה
packages.label_en: Legs — Torah and Prayer as Standing
packages.reason: Torah and Prayer are both a bechina of רַגְלִין (legs/standing): Torah as in 'וְאַתָּה פֹּה עֲמֹד עִמָּדִי' and Prayer as in 'וַיַּעֲמֹד פִּינְחָס וַיְּפַלֵּל'. All three nodes (תורה, תפלה, רגלין) share the essential nature of 'spiritual standing/foundation' — the capacity to stand upright in divine service. The source text explicitly connects עמידה↔רגלין (תורה ותפלה הם בחינת עמידה, שהוא בחינת רגלין), though this bechina edge is missing from the dataset (see additions file). The small pair 'צולע על ירכו' + 'פגם הרגלין' is merged here because it shares the exact same domain — it describes the defective/broken form of legs (limping = defect of the legs), the negative counterstate of this very cluster. The Rebbe uses it to describe the state of the niצוצות before their tikkun: before holy speech they are 'limping on the hip' (the broken leg state), and after being brought to holy speech they are 'building the rib' (the repaired leg state). The domain is: legs/standing/foundation — both in its healthy form and its broken form.

merge_notes.reason: 'Limping on the hip' is a bechina of 'defect of the legs' (צוֹלֵעַ עַל יְרֵכוֹ, שֶׁהוּא בְחִינַת פְּגַם הָרַגְלִין). The Rebbe uses this to describe the state of the sparks before they are brought into holy speech — they are in a state of limping/broken legs. This is the negative/broken form of the same legs-domain that רגלין, תורה, and תפלה represent in their positive form. Thematically it is closest to Package 2 because the shared bechina nature is: the domain of legs, standing, and walking. The polarity note within the package is that this pair represents the broken/unrectified state of that domain.

packages.label: מַחֲלֹקֶת
packages.reason: קשיא (a question/difficulty) is a bechina of מחלקת (dispute/strife/division): when a person encounters a difficulty, their heart is split — things appear to contradict each other and to be in opposition. This is the explicit negative pole of Torah #75's teaching. The entire Torah is about nullifying מדת הנצחון והמחלקת and pursuing שלום (Package 1). The teaching opens with the fact that the quality of strife and dispute comes from the blood-sparks that have not yet been used to serve God. These two nodes share the nature of 'fracture, division, and opposition' — they are the evil domain that Torah and Prayer must overcome. Although only 2 nodes, this component is maintained as a standalone evil package rather than merged into Package 1 because their essential nature (division/fracture) is the opposite of Package 1's nature (unification/peace) — merging them would conflate opposites. They are the evil mirror of Package 1's שלום.
